+def compute_feasible_radii(centers, n):
+    """Compute max feasible radius for each circle given centers."""
+    radii = [1.0 - math.sqrt(xi*xi + yi*yi) for xi, yi in centers]
+    for _ in range(100):
+        changed = False
+        for i in range(n):
+            xi, yi = centers[i]
+            max_r = 1.0 - math.sqrt(xi*xi + yi*yi)
+            for j in range(n):
+                if i != j and radii[j] > 0:
+                    xj, yj = centers[j]
+                    d = math.sqrt((xi-xj)**2 + (yi-yj)**2)
+                    max_r = min(max_r, d - radii[j])
+            max_r = max(0.0, max_r)
+            if abs(radii[i] - max_r) > 1e-12:
+                radii[i] = max_r
+                changed = True
+        if not changed:
+            break
+    return radii
